EarLoft is a player for your own collection: music, podcasts and books, from this device and from the network, each in one shared library. Music also comes from your Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin or Emby servers, podcasts from any feed, and books from your Audiobookshelf server. Everything can be downloaded for offline listening, book progress is synced with your server, and music, podcasts and books also play on your Wear OS watch.

resources.string: Turned-off sections disappear from Start, Library, search, settings and the watch. Nothing is deleted. One section always stays on.
Navidrome, Jellyfin, Emby, music on this device
RSS feeds, podcasts on this device

EarLoft plays your own collection: music from your Navidrome, Subsonic, Jellyfin or Emby server, podcasts from any feed and audiobooks from Audiobookshelf, plus the files on this device. Everything can be downloaded and also plays on your Wear OS watch and in Android Auto.
The next steps set up where it all comes from. You can skip any step and change everything later in the settings.
Choose the sections EarLoft shows. The next steps only cover these.
Add your music server, use the music on this device, or both. Songs that exist on several sources show up once.
Subscribe to podcasts by searching a directory or entering the feed address. Switch on the directories you want to search.
Connect your Audiobookshelf server or use the books in the “Audiobooks” folder on this device.
EarLoft lets you know about new music, episodes and books and shows the progress of downloads. The notification for what is playing appears even without this permission.
Everything you set up here can be changed in the settings. You can also open this setup again there.
Everything you have set up so far is kept. You can open the setup again any time under Settings → General.
